we propose a novel approach to category-level object recognition in point clouds, based on the selective use of 3D SURFs, and a novel kernel, which is able to exploit efficiently the 3D spatial pyramid matching paradigm.

The main takeaway from our work is that

3D spatial pyramid matching can be used for object category recognition from depth images, by using a simple and efficient 3D feature type, which is robust to partial occlusions and viewpoint changes.
the proposed selective volume decomposition strategy can be used as a powerful tool in many 3D vision problems, such as object recognition, object categorization or action recognition.
